capabilities: Import Anki note types into the vault as template files
Sync Obsidian notes, folders, and tags to Anki notes, decks, and tags
Create notes from generated templates with fields mapped to filename, body, and headings
Convert Obsidian wikilinks to Obsidian URL Markdown links
Import content as raw Markdown or rendered HTML
disambiguation: Despite the generic name and manifest wording about 'other note-based software', the README only describes syncing with Anki.
extras: Setup depends on enabling the Obsidian core Templates plugin and configuring the Anki Connect addon config; only one Anki profile can be synced at a time, and troubleshooting relies on the developer console.
motivation: The author wants to follow Zettelkasten principles more strictly by treating each file as a note, mirroring that structure directly into Anki.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn its notes into Anki flashcards while keeping a strict one-file-per-note correspondence between the vault and Anki decks.

relations.evidence: Support arbitrary Anki note type by importing Anki note types as Obsidian note templates
Install Anki Connect in the same way as other Anki plugins.

requires.name: Anki with the Anki Connect addon installed and configured
Obsidian core plugin 'Templates' must be enabled

summary: Syncs Obsidian notes to Anki with 1:1 note/deck/tag correspondence, importing Anki note types as templates and syncing in Markdown or HTML mode.
